title: New dimensions and the 5 to 2 club
content: So I had a new dream last night that doesn't feel new, and rather familiar. I think I have dreamed of this place before and it felt real. The place was a town I went to boarding school at in California but an alternative version of the city even the politics where completely different. The city had switched from sprawling suburbs and cattle ranches to a condensed city with spiral towers with trams. No cars were allowed in the city. There were still cattle ranches but other agriculture turned into underground hydroponic farms. As a result all cattle ranches didn't need to clear cut to create grasslands. Reforestation became popular. In the dream I got hired by the county as a consultant. I got hired because of what I do for a living in the real world. In the real world I work as a life skills instructor for people with developmental disabilities and autism. In the dream I was hired to develop a work place skills program for everyone in the county. Since I did it for people with developmental disabilities they figured I was more likely to be successful in developing a program that's successful for everyone. The county wanted to make it easier for people to change jobs. I was given a penthouse suite overlooking the modern city and the river. After my meeting one of my neighbors invited me to the 5 to 2 club, I remember being awd by the modern city. We walked to a square and around the corner I saw a n shaped building and saw a busling bar n grill that's indoor outdoor. In the club they had an arcade, bowling alley, pool tables and an outdoor play area. They sold 750ml of gard mixed drinks live blizzard 20 to 30 proof. There was no agr limit or drinking limit on alcohol. No body drove in the community because of the trolleys. Wound up bowling with my new neighbors and drinking my chilled blizzard. When I woke up at 6 I had to do a current reality check of the world I live in for an hour. It seemed like a totally real experience that it was tough to adjust to the waking world. Any similar experiences?
